name: Maya Chen
bio: I love helping people ship their first ‘it works!’ moment. I’m here for the small wins, the questions you think are silly, and the confidence you’ll build along the way.

name: Noah Adeyemi
bio: My favorite mentoring style is collaborative: we’ll reason about choices together, keep scope honest, and make your next step feel obvious.

name: Aria Santos
bio: I’m here to make building feel human. We’ll aim for clarity over perfection, and we’ll celebrate progress like it matters—because it does.

name: Devon Park
bio: I like demystifying the parts that feel intimidating: reading unfamiliar code, opening a first PR, and turning feedback into forward motion.

name: Sana Idris
bio: I care about systems that are reliable and explanations that are kind. We’ll keep the scope small, measure what matters, and ship steadily.
